label: common_0225_sitappa_a_01
text: Don’t you get it?! If you join Team Star, you can\nshine as bright as anybody![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_01
text: Seriously, what’s with you? Don’t you wanna\nburn bright with awesome friends like us?[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_botan_02
text: ...Not really.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_02
text: Look—we’ve got a quota we’re supposed to fill\nfor new members, so just sign up already![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_botanl_02
text: Um... I’d rather not...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_0225_select_01
text: Help her out

label: common_0225_select_02
text: Walk away

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_02
text: Huh? You want in on this, too?[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_03
text: If you’re here to sign up, we’ll get to you next!\nWe’ve nearly got this one in the bag![VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_03
text: We’re Team Star, kid. We burn so bright, it hurts\nto look at us! But you knew that, right?[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_04
text:
So you know exactly who you’re messing with,
and you’re still coming at us with that attitude?\c
You’re scary, kid. If you joined Team Star, you’d
be looking down from the top in no time![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_05
text: Ugh, another ignorant little nobody...\c\nHere I’m finally part of Team Star, and still I get\nno respect? I gotta work my way up the ranks...[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_04
text: Hey—we can’t just let something like this slide!\c\nThe honor of our team’s on the line, so we’ve got\nno real choice but to battle, yeah?[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_06
text: That’s true! You keep watch on that little four-\neyes over there![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_07
text: I’ll make sure this fresh-faced nobody ends up\nseeing stars![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_08
text: Urk, why’s a nobody like you so good at battling,\nanyway? That’s just not right...[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_05
text: No way, [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she beat you?![VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_06
text: Does that mean I gotta battle this kid now since\nI’m higher up Team Star’s ranks?![VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_rival_01
text: Pero bueno! What do you think you’re doing?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_09
text: Ugh! It’s that student council dweeb![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_07
text: She’s gonna report us if we don’t book it...[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_rival_02
text: I can’t believe you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_rival_03
text: You don’t have to go find randos to battle! You’ll\nhave all the battles you’ll ever need...with me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_select_03
text: That’s really not what happened...

label: common_0225_select_04
text: It was those Team Star punks...

label: common_0225_rival_04
text: Wait—THEY picked a fight with YOU? Wow, I\nread that way wrong! Sorry![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_rival_05
text:
I get it now. You two have got Team Star written
all over you for sure!\c
I bet you were trying to pressure people into
signing up again, weren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_08
text: Ah, hi. We weren’t...not doing that.[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_rival_06
text: Well, that explains it.\c\nAs head of the student council, stopping this\ntype of nonsense would normally be MY job...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_rival_07
text: But this is also the perfect chance for you to try\nmy amazing and ultra-rare gift to you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_rival_19
text: With this Tera Orb, you can [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terastallize[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] your\nPokémon during battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_rival_20
text: Let’s see. After it Terastallizes, I’m pretty sure\nyour [VAR 0x0101(0001)] will beee...[VAR 0x1302(0002,0000)][VAR 0x0103(0002)] type![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_rival_08
text: Normally you’ve gotta take special classes to be\nable to get one of these Tera Orbs, but I put in\r\na good word for you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_rival_09
text: Now, time to give it a whirl! You’ll learn to use it\nfaster in battle than if I just explain it to you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_09
text: Wait, what? You want this kid to practice whaling\non us with h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser Tera Pokémon, is that it?[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_rival_10
text: Got a problem? You wanna battle me instead?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_10
text: Hnnng... Never mind! I’ll take my chances with\nthe new kid![VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_rival_11
text: Then take your places, and...battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text:
Sometimes you’ll find a Pokémon whose Tera
Type is totally different from its usual type. That
difference can open up your strategic options!\c
Gotta charge your Tera Orb at a Pokémon Center
after every use by healing up your team, though.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_b_11
text: W-well... I’ll be on my merry way, then, yeah?\nHasta la vistaaarrr! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: common_0225_sitappa_a_10
text: Me, too! Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: common_0225_rival_14
text: So, yeah—Team Star is basically a group of\nstudents that like to kick up trouble.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_rival_15
text:
They hardly ever show up to class, and when they
get together in groups, they’re a real headache.\c
Even the teachers don’t know what to do with
’em, from what I hear...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0225_botan_03
text: Um...’scuse me![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_0225_botan_04
text: I...uh... I just... Well, thanks.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_0225_botan_05
text: So, yeah... See you around.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

text: I don’t think I’ve seen that girl around. Maybe\nshe’s a new transfer, like you...\c\nThat Eevee bag, though! Love that fluff![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text:
Anyway, seems like the trouble’s died down, so
we’d better book it up to school!\c
Get ready to climb the worst staircase in
